title: Standard Gauge — Material Film Strip Inspection
subtitle: Examining 16mm/35mm reels, duplicated frames, emulsion decay, and projection light
lineage: Lineage: Morgan Fisher, Standard Gauge (1984) · Supporting: SCION 070 (Rose Hobart), SCION 072 (Decasia)
theorem: Place the physical film strip, projection mechanism, and emulsion history at the center of attention so the audience sees how every archival image is carried by a vulnerable material strip.
boundary_note: Combines SCION 071 (Standard Gauge apparatus inspection) with SCION 072 (Decasia emulsion decay) while keeping each strip's archival provenance explicit.

critic_tribunal.largest_gap: Moves cleanly from hands holding a 16mm reel (`8266284b`) and open projector (`a134989d`) to a strip of repeated frames (`8d958ac4`), bleached emulsion (`497f7a8c`), and cinema audience (`3b380682`).
critic_tribunal.falsifiable_repair: All 6 apparatus and emulsion shots verified cut-free.
